facts.fact: The Ministry of Agriculture says the Agence togolaise de normalisation (ATN), a technical structure of the Haute Autorite de la Qualite et de l'Environnement (HAUQE), drew up 46 national standards, all on agri-food value chains (rice, soya, poultry, meat), with FSRP-Togo support, disseminated at Lome on 17-18 August 2026; none is stated to be on information technology or data, and the document does not say what law or decree set ATN up.

note: No IT or data standard and no IT certification stated: COTAG's 31 certification programmes cover rice, soya, poultry, sorghum, tubers and fruit, so are class other and give no certification fact.
